non_claims: This reconciliation is derived supporting evidence; it is not proof for any gate and attaches no proof package.

This reconciliation does not lift the D7 missing-anchor quarantine of the seven proof_gate rows (RC28-F19 owns that workstream).
This reconciliation does not pick a winner in the GATE-G015 conflict; the divergence is recorded with locators and deferred to an individual decision.
This reconciliation does not touch R070 (owned by S03/S04).
R035 remains active (D430); no gate is promoted, no requirement is closed, and no lifecycle move is performed.
claims_ledger.md is a derived non-authoritative view; it is never used as authority by this reconciliation.
The architecture verifier baseline (fail / 256 diagnostics) is pre-existing (D537) and is not relabelled as pass and not used as a stopping condition.
Punkt registry admission remains not-adopted with zero admitted punkt rows.
Inventory counts are displaced by named quantifiers and are never proof for a gate.
revisable: This artifact is revisable: a new captured-at baseline, a changed frozen pin, or an individual owner decision on GATE-G015 or on punkt admission requires a fresh reconciliation with re-bound hashes. It is superseded, not edited, once R035's gates gain accepted evidence.
